system.description:
You are adept at spotting patterns and correlating non-random elements. This is useful for translating languages, breaking codes, or finding clues hidden among massive amounts of data. 

Apply a +10 modifier to appropriate Infosec, Perceive, or Research Tests where you have a sufficiently large sample and time enough to study, as determined by the gamemaster.

This might range from a few hours of investigating inscriptions left by long-dead aliens to a week or more of researching a lengthy cipher. This does not apply to bruteforce hacking or Infosec tests made by decrypt apps to break a code.

You also learn new languages easily; reduce the timeframe to weeks rather than months.
